items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: And then after that, then I worked with Duke at the theatre down here.

ctx.x: Did you work with the band?

Yeah, with the band. See, and Frank Daly's Meadowbrook, and then I did some theatre things with them and all that. All I had to do is call back here and tell them I wouldn't be back for a couple of weeks or a month. And then, later, I worked with -- this was here in Chicago, I worked with Woody again here at the old Panther Room, yeah. And then after that, then I worked with Duke at the theatre down here. It used to be the old Rialto Theatre, and then they called it the Downtown, at Congress and State.
